$comment: Note schema v2 (spec §7.2): text fields cite numbers only as {ref:<id>} tokens from the call's MEASUREMENTS block, and refs_used lists them. The claim checker rejects any digit or quantity word outside a token before the note is saved.

observation.description: What was measured or seen. Every number as a {ref:<id>} token.

interpretation.description: What it may mean. Numbers only as {ref:<id>} tokens.

next_step.description: A suggestion, labeled as such, or empty.

refs_used.description: Every ref id cited in the text.

evidence_ids.description: Frame or event ids the note rests on.
